label: vocr6-spotter3
frozen_before: any read of a new arm (F, D, F+D) on any set: hval, unseen dev, the tight sets, the confirmation set, the test sets
what: No training. textspot6's trained spotters (#128, PR #147, docs/textspot6.md), each arm's representative its median seed, with (F) a per-region fallback to Rubi's finder rubi,fix=1, (D) a decode post-pass on the spotter's boxes, and F+D; decided by textspot6's rule unchanged, plus a fresh confirmation set of unseen games read once at the end.

diagnosis.source: textspot6's stored dev rows and whole-frame spot files of the representatives and the baselines ($A/vocr6-spotter/eval/<run>/), read before this protocol; per-VN notes in docs/textspot7.md 'Diagnosis'
diagnosis.v27449: GRAD + refine and rubi,fix=1 read 2 lines as one box in both regions of one screenshot (44-50 errors per unit); every det representative boxes them apart (1-5 errors)
diagnosis.v1971: the whole loss is one region of two side-by-side choices (3 variants): the reference lists the right choice first (its ink box is 1 px higher); every representative reads both choices whole and correct, left to right; rubi,fix=1 reads the right one only. A reference-order artifact: no arm is aimed at it; reported as a sensitivity row
diagnosis.v20524: one region (a dark-on-light UI-style line): the det representatives give low-confidence fragments (conf 4-14) or no box; rubi,fix=1 reads it with 0 errors
diagnosis.v8410: one region: every det representative's box joins this line with text to its left, so the box's centre is outside the region and the region gets no box; rubi,fix=1 reads it with 0 errors
diagnosis.v3496: one region of 2 tightly spaced lines: 3 of 4 det representatives put both in one box (7 errors per unit); rubi,fix=1 boxes them apart (0 errors)
diagnosis.v20170_v454: crop-decode losses (a line cut into 2 boxes or cut short); the det decodes read them like rubi,fix=1. The crop decodes are not arms here
diagnosis.hval_existing_arms: hval is the fitting set: rubi,fix=1 makes 5,349 errors of 162,471 characters (2,581 in PCSG00854: GRAD junk rows; 677 in ULJM05674: merged rows); the det representatives 2,116-2,552. Their own failures there: lines cut at an edge (1-2 characters, a median 0.4-0.6 line heights beyond the box) far more often than fragmented lines; merged lines (base_qS4)

spotters.decode: det: textspot6's whole-frame spot (synth/textspot6_twin.spot) on the frame in the console view (a PSP frame upscaled 2x); a region keeps the horizontal boxes whose centre lies in it, clipped to it (eval/textspot6.py region_boxes / eval/pagepath.py --frame-boxes); every tag
spotters.why_these: each arm's median seed by unseen-dev page-path CER in the det decode (textspot6's representatives, eval/textspot6_dev_20261027.json); never the best seed

F.name: spotter + GRAD fallback
F.per_region: run both rubi,fix=1 (G: GRAD TEXTBOX_RECOVERY, its short-line probe, COLGAP, the refinement on PSP titles, on the player's region) and the spotter (S: the det boxes of the region); show S or G, never a mix

features.rows: the boxes of a set grouped into rows: two boxes are in one row when their vertical overlap is at least half the smaller height (transitively, in order of top)
features.cmed: the median confidence of S's boxes (the decode's box conf, 0-127; the lower middle for an even count)
features.S_lacks_row: a row of G whose height is at least lambda x the median height of S's boxes and that no S box overlaps vertically by at least half the row's height
features.G_merge: a G box that holds the centres of 2 or more S boxes of different rows

family.mode S (spotter by default): show G when S is empty and G is not, or cmed < tau, or (lambda on) some row S_lacks_row; else S
family.mode G (GRAD by default): show S when G_merge and cmed >= tau; else G (lambda unused)

F.fit: per representative, on hval only: the grid point with the fewest hval page-path dialogue errors (computed from the stored per-unit rows: F's text on a unit is the chosen set's, read from the same crops; then confirmed through eval/pagepath.py --boxes, which must reproduce it unit for unit). Ties: mode S, then the larger tau, then the smaller lambda (off last)
F.reads: none new: every crop F shows is a crop of G's or S's stored run (the reading cache holds it)

D.name: decode post-pass on the spotter's boxes (no GRAD)

steps_in_order.assign: a horizontal frame box also belongs to the region when its part inside the region is at least 0.6 of its height tall and at least 1.0 of its height wide (else textspot6's centre rule); clipped to the region
steps_in_order.join(gamma): two boxes of the region in one row (vertical overlap >= 0.6 of the smaller height) with a horizontal gap <= gamma x the larger height (overlapping boxes included) become their union, at the earlier box's place in the decode order (dark: the wider box's, conf: the smaller); repeated in decode order
steps_in_order.extend: each box grows left and right over ink of its own rows: a column is inked when at least 2 of its pixels in the box's rows have a 3x3 contrast (max - min) >= t, t = max(40, 2/5 of the 99th percentile of that contrast inside the box) (eval/pagepath.ink_points' threshold); the scan goes outward at most 1.5 box heights, ends after a gap of more than 0.5 box heights, and stops at the region's edge and at another box of the row; the new edge is the last inked column plus max(2, round(0.15 x height)) px; a box only grows
steps_in_order.tighten: runtime/vocr_lines_refine.c with VOCR_REFINE_TIGHTEN alone on the region in the console view (each box's rows cut to its main text band plus 16% of the band; columns kept)

D.fit: on hval only, pooled over the four representatives: each step alone added to the plain det decode (assign, join 0.5, join 1.0, extend, tighten: 5 variants x 4 representatives through eval/pagepath.py) is kept when it lowers the pooled hval page-path dialogue errors; join keeps the better gamma when both lower; D is every kept step together, in the order above, the same for every representative. If no step is kept, D is the plain decode and is not a candidate
D.reads: new crops, through the pinned page path (heavy.sh)

F+D.name: F's fallback over D's boxes
F+D.what: D's boxes are S; F's family and grid re-fit on hval per representative from D's hval rows, as F
F+D.when: after the single arms are scored, as one confirmation pair

arms.candidates: every representative x {D, F, F+D}: 12 (D and F+D only if D keeps a step)
arms.not_arms: no training, no new shapes, no distillation (vocr6-spotter2's), no crop decodes, no reading-order change

page_path.pinned: textspot6's: $A/vocr6-spotter/pagepath_snap135/repo/eval/pagepath.py (main 8a71eec + #135), its pagepath_find.c and vocr_lines_fix.*, Rubi textnorm 213fd60
page_path.read: VOCR5-N W8I with the top 8, the counter re-decode, beam 8 + the 1 MB LM (vocr_lm_o3_1000k), the cascade to VOCR5-L below a greedy confidence of 0.7, Rubi's text rules, non_japanese_filter lines

unseen_dev.what: #119's 1,161 whole-dialogue units (387 regions x base / +4 / +8, 93 VNs); the headline leaves out v12188 (a hooked training title): 1,143 units, 92 VNs

page_path.metric: page-path dialogue CER; paired differences with 10,000 cluster-bootstrap resamples (seed 0): VN clusters on dev and on the confirmation set, title clusters on hval (eval/pagepath.py compare)

rule.source: textspot6's rule unchanged (eval/textspot6_protocol.json 'rule'), with the fallback's cost counted and the confirmation condition added
rule.eligible: VTSP bytes <= 512,000; est. ms @333 <= 300 per 960 x 544 frame including the fallback's cost; arena <= 262,144; C == twin on every development frame (the spotter: textspot6's parity; F's choice and D's boxes: the C code here against its twin on every unseen-dev and hval unit)
rule.cost_of_F: the spotter's row of record (eval/textspot6_a9_20261026.json, with the dark pass) + rubi,fix=1 on the player's region: the A9 cycle model's high bound x 1.0007 (textspot6's calibration, vita/a9_cycles.py) of eval/pagepath_find.c's GRAD with Rubi's settings (TEXTBOX_RECOVERY, the probe, fix=1, the refinement as on a PSP title) on the largest of #119's 387 base regions in the console view; the mean, median and a full 960 x 544 region are reported beside it
rule.cost_of_D: the spotter's row of record + D's post-pass, the same A9 method on the development units' boxes (the largest per-region cost)
rule.arena: the spotter, the fallback and the post-pass run one after another and keep only boxes between them: the arena is the largest of the three
rule.beats_grad_refine: unseen dev: page-path dialogue CER difference (candidate - GRAD + refine, eval/pagepath.py --finder rubi) with a 95% VN-cluster interval entirely below 0; hval: the difference not resolved above 0
rule.cost_order: VTSP bytes, est. ms @333 per 960 x 544 frame, arena, then D before F before F+D, then the arm's name
rule.pick: among the qualifiers that meet the confirmation condition: the cheapest; a costlier one replaces it when, against it, unseen-dev page-path CER is resolved below 0 and hval is not resolved above 0; repeated until none does
rule.confirmation: a qualifier must also be not resolved worse than rubi,fix=1 on the confirmation set (paired, VN clusters: the 95% interval of candidate - rubi,fix=1 does not lie entirely above 0). The set is read once, for every qualifier at the same time, after the dev and hval decision is recorded
rule.vocr6_guard: if vocr6-lead has released VOCR6-N (a vita-vn-ocr release Rubi pins) before the decision, the pick is also read with it (as Rubi ships it: its LM and cascade) on unseen dev and hval against rubi,fix=1 on the same path: neither difference may be resolved above 0 (not resolved worse); otherwise no pick. Without such a release the guard is the pinned path itself and is reported as moot
rule.no_qualifier: negative verdict with the per-VN table and what would fix the rest; no release, no Rubi PR
rule.with_pick: retrain the pick's spotter on train + guard + hval with its recipe and seed (textspot6's with_pick), release it as a vita-vn-ocr pre-release with SHA256SUMS, read the test sets once (report only: the test title through the page path, CLANNAD, vita-test + psp-test as textspot6 amendment 13 reads them), and open a normal Rubi_for_vita PR (the fallback in C, an off-switch defaulting to the measured best, the memory ledger exact, both Vita builds, the fast gate), merged on the local fast gate (owner 2026-10-26 11:33Z), audited in parallel, and carried in the single Rubi test build (rubi-test-consolidate)
rule.rubi_default: the pick is Rubi's default finder only if, against rubi,fix=1 on the same units, unseen dev is resolved below 0 and hval not resolved above 0 (and the confirmation and VOCR6 conditions hold); otherwise it ships behind its setting, off by default. Only one spotter can be Rubi's default: if vocr6-spotter2's also passes, the better under this same rule, agreed with vocr6-spotter2 and vocr6-lead before any merge

confirmation_set.why: the losing VNs were found on the decision set (the 1,161 unseen-dev units), so a fix aimed at them reads optimistically there
confirmation_set.exclusions: VN ids, agreed with vocr6-spotter2 at 06:45Z: every hooked title (all splits), textspot2's real half (52,785 canvases: 11,318 VNs), textspot's synthetic frames' scene backgrounds (1,117 VNs), #119's units and the dev sample with its release partners, textspot's development frames, the test sets with their release partners and capture sessions, the owner's screenshot VNs, eval/linefind's sets (GRAD's tuning); vocr6-spotter2 adds none without telling first (eval/textspot7_confirm.py pool)

frames.what: 454 frames of 50 VNs (PSP 364, Vita 90; 8 duplicates dropped): native-size VNDB screenshots of 45 VNs (eval/'s 2026-10-09 VNDB listings, the content filters) and the fresh native textbox frames (press and blog screenshots) of 5 VNs. Frozen before any new arm is read

confirmation_set.units: the whole-dialogue regions of up to 6 accepted frames per VN, taken in the frozen review order: each text box's dialogue and narration lines (in-story choices too; speaker names left out), the region their ink boxes' union plus 12 px (Vita) / 6 px (PSP) native, and the variants expanded-4 / expanded-8 (eval's and #119's rule); a line's cells are even splits of its ink box. A frame is skipped when its text box holds a line the reviewers cannot decide or the proposals miss
confirmation_set.labelling: PP-OCRv6 small and MeikiOCR proposals (teacher/engines: Meiki's detector and recognizer, PP-OCRv6 small on each horizontal Meiki box with eval's pad), then Claude adjudication on contact sheets (one sheet per frame, <= 1280 px a side, one image per tool call, <= ~60 images per session; helpers vocr6-spotter3-label-*), reviewer_kind assistant; the reading order is rows top to bottom (a row: boxes overlapping vertically by half the smaller height) and left to right in a row, fixed before any read. The reviewers never see an arm's output
confirmation_set.frozen: the units file and its sha256 (and the public manifest: ids, VNs, URLs, sha256, regions and line boxes, no text) are committed before the confirmation read; the reference text stays private
confirmation_set.read: console view (Vita as is, PSP upscaled 2x bilinear on the colour frame, then grey: what Rubi gets); the spotter on the whole frame (det), every finder on the unit's region cut from that frame; the same page path; once, by an attempt record that refuses a second read
confirmation_set.size: at most 6 frames per VN (<= 300 frames): far inside AGENTS.md's held-out budget (the hooked corpus alone is 55,493 pages)
confirmation_set.shared: vocr6-spotter2 uses the same frozen set as its not-resolved-worse guard and keeps its VNs out of its training

report_only: the qualifiers and the baselines on vocr6-finder's tight units (dev_tight, hval_tight, hval_tight2)
v1971 with its two side-by-side choices scored in either order (the reference-order sensitivity)
per-VN and per-title tables of every candidate against rubi,fix=1 and GRAD + refine; every seed of each arm with F and D at the representative's fitted settings
estimates: every console time is a host A9 cycle-model estimate (textspot6's calibration); nothing runs on a console
slots: vocr6/slots.txt share (0 until ~08:30Z, then 1): every page-path read, the labelling proposals, A9 runs and the retrain go through heavy.sh; short gates under the gate locks

amendments.before: any read of a new arm (no F, D or F+D box, choice or score exists yet)
amendments.why: checking the frozen definitions against the diagnosis cases by hand, before writing code: as written, S_lacks_row would send v27449 to GRAD (each of the spotter's two boxes covers 32 of the merged GRAD box's 69 rows, under half), against the diagnosis it was built from; the other items make the definitions exact for the C twin or match the dev units' pixel convention

changes.F.features.S_lacks_row: replaced by S_lacks: a G box at least lambda x the median height of S's boxes tall whose rows are less than half covered by the union of the vertical extents of the S boxes that overlap it horizontally (integer: 2 x covered < h)
changes.F.features.S_short: added (mode S only): a G box b and the S boxes of its row (vertical overlap >= half the smaller height) such that b reaches beyond their union by more than kappa x b's height at either end; mode S shows G when it holds for some G box (kappa off: never). Built from the diagnosis's hval finding that the spotters' commonest failure there is a line cut short at an edge
changes.F.fit.ties: mode S, then the larger tau, then the smaller lambda (off last), then the smaller kappa (off last): the most fallback
changes.F.medians: cmed and the median height are the lower middle of the sorted values (index (n - 1) // 2)
changes.D.extend.threshold: t = max(40, (2 x p99) // 5), p99 the lower-rank 99th percentile of the 3x3 contrast inside the box (sorted value at index (99 x (n - 1)) // 100); max reach (3 x h) // 2, gap end h // 2, pad max(2, (15 x h + 50) // 100); the row of a box for the stop rule as join's (vertical overlap >= 0.6 of the smaller height)
changes.D.join.integer: same row: 10 x overlap >= 6 x the smaller height; gap = the larger left edge - the smaller right edge; joined when 10 x gap <= 10 x gamma x the larger height
changes.confirmation_set.read.view: the dev units' convention (#119, textspot6's dev frames): a unit's region stored native and grey, a PSP one upscaled 2x bilinear after the cut by eval/pagepath.py; the spotter's frame the grey frame, a PSP one upscaled 2x bilinear (textspot6.dev_frames)
changes.confirmation_set.labelling.boxes: the reviewer may split a proposal box that holds several lines (split at the ink rows between them) and add a missed line with an approximate box (refined to ink, teacher/geometry); a frame is skipped only when a line's text or extent cannot be decided. Line ink boxes are refined to ink on the native frame (teacher/geometry.refine); a group of lines that a player would draw as one region is one unit (in-story choices one group per menu)
changes.F.family.mode_G: show S when G is empty and S is not, or when G_merge and cmed >= tau; else G (the empty rule mirrors mode S's)
changes.F.features.S_short.scope: only a G box with at least one S box in its row counts (a row without S boxes is S_lacks' case)
changes.F.geometry: a box's centre is (2x + w, 2y + h) in half pixels, inside a box when 2x0 <= cx < 2(x0 + w) (and in y); rows: union-find over the pairs with 2 x vertical overlap >= the smaller height

amendments.before: any review decision on the confirmation set and any read of a new arm on it (only its proposals and sheets exist)
amendments.why: the frozen frame list holds 42 frames of translated releases (English, Chinese, Russian; eval/'s VNDB listings record the release languages), and the review rules said nothing about language; and the batch plan's view cap was not written down

changes.confirmation_set.labelling.language: a frame is accepted only for Japanese story text; a frame whose story text is in another language is skipped as 'not Japanese' (the frames stay in the frozen list)
changes.confirmation_set.labelling.view_cap: the reviewers see at most the first 12 frames of a VN in the frozen review order (eval/textspot7_confirm.py sheets --cap-view 12); a VN closes at 6 accepted frames; the review tool hands out the frames in that order
changes.confirmation_set.labelling.batches: 9 batches of 3-7 VNs (at most 48 sheets each), one Claude helper per batch (vocr6-spotter3-label-*), then a second look by another helper at every accepted line whose text equals neither engine's reading and at every split or added line (eval/textspot7_confirm.py recheck-sheets): it picks a reading, writes the text, or marks it unsure (the frame then drops)

amendments.before: the confirmation read (no arm has run on any confirmation frame)
amendments.labelling_as_done: 9 batches reviewed by 9 Claude helpers (vocr6-spotter3-label-1..9, reviewer_kind assistant), 383 sheets offered, 323 frames decided, 170 accepted (the rest: no dialogue, not Japanese, undecidable, not a game frame); the second look covered the 30 accepted lines whose text matched neither engine or that were added by hand (29 confirmed, 1 corrected)
amendments.deviation: amendment 2 named another helper for the second look; no agent capacity was free (30 of 25 running), so it was done by this label's own session, a different Claude session than every first reviewer, which had seen no arm output on any confirmation frame (none existed); 3 zooms
amendments.dev_reads_before_freeze: the dev and hval reads of the arms (and the dev-phase record, f62c2e8) came before this freeze; the frame list and the review rules were frozen before any arm read (ae1dd78, amendments 1-2), and the reviewers never saw an arm's output

amendments.kind: process only (no read, no rule of the selection changes)
amendments.what: vocr6-lead's rulings (2026-10-27 10:35Z and ~12:52Z): Rubi gets ONE spotter. vocr6-spotter2's textspot8 student (#149) passed its own registered default test, so it ships as Rubi's default finder; textspot7's pick is released in vita-vn-ocr (v0.3.9-textspot7.1) and is NOT pinned in Rubi, so rule.with_pick's Rubi PR is not opened
amendments.unchanged: the pick, every record, the release and the test reads

amendments.kind: erratum and disclosure (audit-vocr6-spotter3 F1, F2); no read, no rule change
amendments.F1_post_pass_rewrite: the post-pass's C contrast pass was rewritten row-separable at about 08:23-08:26Z, AFTER the hval and dev reads (07:36-08:22Z) and before the dev record (f62c2e8, 08:35Z), with the results in view. Its output is the same (C == twin re-checked on every dev, hval and confirmation unit), and the rule reads the code's cost. But it decided the eligible set: with the first code's A9 rows (max 95.1-98.8 ms) only base_qS4|D was within 300 ms (294.6 ms) and it would have been the pick (it qualifies and passes the confirmation condition); with the rewritten code base_t64n8c16|D (296.3 ms), kd|D and qL5|D became eligible and t64|D, the cheapest by bytes, is the pick, 3.7 ms under the budget (an estimate). Rubi's default is grad either way
